About

You choose a person, not a brand

Accredited Mental Health Social Worker · Recognised by the AASW

Safe Oasis provides evidence-based, trauma-informed therapeutic support led by an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker. The approach is person-centred, culturally responsive and strengths-based — meeting you where you are, at a pace that feels safe.

  • Bilingual English & Turkish — genuine cultural and language access, not an interpreter add-on.
  • Scheme approved & experienced — SIRA, Victims Services, WDO and NDIS pathways many practices can't offer.
  • Assessment & reporting capability — psychosocial and functional capacity assessments, NDIS evidence, and insurer or court reports.
Read more about the approach

If you need help right now

Safe Oasis is not an emergency or crisis service. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, please call 000. For 24/7 support, these free, confidential services can help.
